speakers.headline: Software designer and developer
speakers.biographyMd:
Paolo Rubano is a software designer and developer with over 30 years of experience, having worked in the industry since 1992.
Throughout his career, he has consistently been involved in the development of mission-critical systems across a wide range of industries. His technical background spans several programming languages, from C, Pascal, and Modula2 to C++, and ultimately Java.
Always eager to embrace innovation, he has continuously surfed the wave of emerging technologies, methodologies, and software development processes, adapting to the rapidly evolving IT landscape.
